description: GKW Limited provides warehousing and logistics solutions in India. It operates in two segments: Warehousing, and Investment and Treasury. The company leases warehousing facilities; and invests in bank deposits, equity instruments, bonds and mutual funds, and alternative investment funds. It serves its services to textile, lubricants, agricultural tools, paints, jewellery, consumer products, hosiery products, plywood and laminates, pet products, E-commerce, and telecommunication industries. The company was formerly known as Guest Keen Williams Limited. GKW Limited was incorporated in 1931 and is headquartered in Howrah, India. GKW Limited is a subsidiary of Matrix Commercial Private Limited.
